settings_cog_R2.on_the_satellite_icon: badge: a solid disc r40 with a gap r50 cut round it in the speaker, at (146,146); the cog is scaled 0.32 inside it (it was 0.4, which was too big).

clive_chat.note: Notifications icon (approved 2026-11-01): the Clive pair as a chat. Two rounded squares, the front one with a squared bottom-left corner as the tail, even-odd so the overlap is cut out, drawn then scaled 1.05 about the origin and moved (-5.25, 0.1). Not a bell: it matches the rest of the set. Used by the Notifications and Notification styles rows (cd_clive_chat).

clive_mic.note: Clive's microphone: the open-and-waiting (Ready) pose of his mark, a capsule 72 tall over a flat bar. Capsule length approved 2026-11-01 on the icon board (64 was too short, 88 touched the bar when it breathes). It morphs out of the two squircles of the logo; AssistantGlyph animates it (capsule breathes in Ready, becomes a pulsing square while you speak). Drawn at 1.3 scale about the centre in the settings rows (cd_clive_mic).
clive_mic.also: Every microphone in the apps is this one: cd:mic / cd:mic-off (slash) / cd:mic-message (smaller, beside a chat bubble with three dots) in CdIcons.kt, reached through the alias from mdi:microphone, mdi:microphone-off and mdi:microphone-message, and built into the Home Assistant cards (src/icons.js, CLIVE_ICONS). The satellite mic badge (sat_device_mic) has the same capsule, 36 tall at badge scale.
